subject: Conflict between Sheet S-301 and Structural Detail 3/S502 over the shear wall hold-down

messages.text: The shear wall hold-down location shown in Sheet S-301 at Gridline B/2 conflicts with the mechanical ductwork and architectural ceiling framing routing shown in Structural Detail 3/S502. This needs immediate attention -- please prioritize a response. No cost impact is anticipated either way. This is holding up steel fabrication release. A response within three weeks would let us keep the erection sequence on track.

Revise the shear wall hold-down per Structural Detail 3/S502; coordinate final dimensions with the affected trades before fabrication. No cost impact is anticipated either way. This is holding up steel fabrication release.

To confirm, should the shear wall hold-down at Gridline B/2 remain per Sheet S-301, or do we wait for a revised Structural Detail 3/S502? A response within three weeks would let us keep the erection sequence on track.
